narrative: An employee was manually loading a packaging film roll onto a machine spindle when the roll slipped from his hands and landed on his right index finger. The employee's finger was partially amputated.
event: Struck by object dropped by person
notes: evidence: A heavy roll slipped from his hands onto his finger.

narrative: An employee was manually lifting a 2-inch roll of paper weighing 58 pounds onto the line when they suffered a lower back injury. The employee was hospitalized.
event: Overexertion while materials moving by hand
notes: evidence: They hurt their back lifting a 58-pound paper roll.

narrative: An employee was operating a thermoforming machine when their fingers became caught in the cutting section and the employee sustained amputation of three fingers.
event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment  normal operation
source: Extruding, injecting, forming, molding machinery  n.e.c.
notes: evidence: Their fingers got caught in the machine's cutting part.

narrative: An employee was working to get a log back onto a carriage. The employee came into contact with the running saw, which amputated their arm.
event: Struck by running powered equipment  unspecified
notes: evidence: The worker touched a running saw while moving a log.

narrative: An employee was polishing a guide pin using a CNC lathe when his left glove got caught on the chuck or tool and three of his fingers were pulled in. The employee was hospitalized and underwent reattachment surgery for finger amputations.
event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment  normal operation
notes: evidence: His glove got caught in a spinning lathe.

narrative: An employee was walking by a forklift with a load when he slipped and fell. A forklift ran over his right foot behind the steel toe of his boot, resulting in a broken foot.
event: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area  unspecified
source: Forklift, order picker, platform truck powered
notes: evidence: He slipped and a forklift ran over his foot.

narrative: An employee was using an overhead crane to align a tooling rack. The employee's hand slipped and the tooling rack shifted, pinching his right fifth finger. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
event: Struck by suspended or swinging objects  n.e.c.
notes: evidence: A moving rack pinched his finger while using a crane.

narrative: An employee was positioning an overhead crane to stand up a skidded coil when the coil swung back. The employee was caught between the swinging coil and another coil sitting on a coil pad, resulting in hospitalization due to a loss of consciousness and a pelvic injury.
event: Struck by suspended or swinging objects  n.e.c.
notes: evidence: A swinging coil hit the worker against another coil.

narrative: An employee was walking when they were struck by a bucket elevator machine and sustained a fractured left ankle.
event: Struck by running powered equipment  n.e.c.
notes: evidence: A moving bucket elevator hit the worker.

narrative: At 2:45 p.m., an employee was outside the plant during a break before his next shift. He was speaking with an associate when he suddenly fell from the third-level steps to the ground, striking his head on the concrete. The employee was hospitalized due to internal brain bleeding, a wound to the back of his head requiring staples, and heat-related dehydration.
event: Other fall to lower level  unspecified
nature: Cerebral and other intracranial hemorrhages without skull fracture
notes: evidence: He fell down the stairs and hit his head on concrete.

narrative: An employee was operating a wax injection die. The die's metal lid (which weighed about 125 pounds) fell on his hand. He suffered crush injuries to the index and middle fingers that required surgery.
event: Struck by falling part of vehicle or machine, still attached
notes: evidence: A 125-pound metal lid fell on his hand.

narrative: An employee was operating a brake press when the top die broke, causing the bottom die to roll out and onto the employee's legs. Both of the employee's legs were crushed below the knee, and both legs were partially amputated. The employee's left leg was also fractured above the knee.
event: Struck by dislodged or detached object(s)
notes: evidence: Part of a brake press broke and rolled onto his legs.

narrative: An employee was running a test pipe for 12 feet and went to pull the pipe out of a roll grooving tool. As he was doing this, the tool's control pedal actuated, causing the tool to rotate. The employee's glove became caught and was pulled into the rollset, amputating about half an inch of his index finger.
event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment  normal operation
source: Bending, rolling, shaping, stamping machinery  n.e.c.
notes: evidence: The pedal turned on the rollers and pulled his glove in.

narrative: An employee was cleaning an upper mezzanine. When he leaned against the mezzanine gate, he fell through the gate opening and landed 11 feet below. The employee sustained fractured orbital bones.
event: Other fall to lower level  6 to 30 feet
notes: evidence: He leaned on a mezzanine gate and fell 11 feet.

narrative: An employee had isolated, depressurized, and de-energized the south filter canister to replace a filter. They loosened the pressurized lid of the north canister, resulting in hot oil spraying them. The employee was hospitalized with burns to their arms and neck. Personal protective equipment (PPE) was not worn at the time.
event: Contact with hot objects or substances
notes: evidence: Hot oil sprayed him when he opened a pressurized lid without PPE.
